_why: Chinese needles for merchant-console-guide.contract.ps1. They live HERE, not inline in the .ps1: Windows PowerShell 5.1 parses a BOM-less script as ANSI, which corrupts Chinese literals BEFORE the script runs (the repo already lost a whole mutation round to that). The contract reads this file with an explicit UTF-8 decoder. The pre-existing code-point needles stay inline in the contract.
